headline: Building | Sigma Squared Fellow | ex-Microsoft, Endeavor

posts.text:
AI gave everyone a kitchen
now we get to see who can actually cook 🧑‍🍳🔥 

having a kitchen doesn’t automatically make you a great chef  🤌 

good cooking also takes instinct, taste, and knowing who’s at the table, 
and what they might actually want after a long day 

that’s why on August 28, we’re bringing Formidable Builders  
➡️ engineers, marketers, growth people, and operators  ⬅️  
into the Builders House kitchen, 

for the.. 🥁 Europe's first Agent Skillathon 🥁 (& focused on GTM)

OpenAI for Developers (Codex) can help you cook, and
Apify can bring ingredients from basically everywhere across the internet

.. and for dessert, we have $4,500 in prizes for the winners🤩🥳 
 
🔥 come cook with us ↓
https://luma.com/82q9aclg

Apify joined the party, will you?  🥳 🥳 
if you are in Bucharest on the 28th, you definitely should!!!!  🚒 

what's the "party" about: use OpenAI (codex) to build a reusable agent skill that does a real go-to-market job - powered by live web data by Apify <3 - and create the evals that prove it works!

have I already mentioned that this is the first agent‑skill hackathon in Europe? 🤔  how 🆒  is it that we are making it happen in Bucharest?? 

since the eu/acc Romania community became Formidable Builders, we kept our conviction: the best way to understand what’s next is to build it, and where else it could take place if not at home, at Builders House? 

ALSO, the total prize pool is $4,500 in credits from our partners  😍🤑 

 👉  sign up here & see you soon: https://luma.com/82q9aclg  👈

❗❗  Europe's first agent skills hackathon is here  ❗❗

Together with Alexandru C. and Gabriel Moncha we've prepared a skillathon, with the goal of creating the best GTM skills and the evals to prove it.

Because - yes - distribution is king!

For this one, we've partnered with OpenAI Developers, Builders House and stock.estate

If you're in Bucharest, on August 28th, join for a night full of formidable skills  🚀 
https://luma.com/82q9aclg

people keep talking about the agent economy as if it starts in 2030 
🔻 IT HAS ALREADY STARTED!!🔻 

agents are discovering, installing, and paying for products without waiting for a human to guide them through the funnel

with 250K agents on its network, Pilot Protocol is already building the distribution layer through which agents discover and adopt new capabilities

i remember the first time Răzvan showed me Pilot, i was genuinely mesmerized.. not only by what the product could do, but by what it meant for distribution

join at pilotprotocol.network - your agent probably already has, at https://lnkd.in/gw8dzNHE 

amazing job!!

happy st. patrick’s day to everyone creating their own luck 🇺🇸🍀 
cause the best kind of luck is the one you build, right?

day by day, I’m more fascinated by how being “non-tech” doesn’t mean being far from tech anymore 
the more I learn, the more I understand what can be built and what the future could look like 

which, for a non tech person, feels like unlocking a whole new world

thanks Apify and Lovable for the credits  and the learnings 🫶 
and the European Startup Embassy for hosting us. this was really fun!
